coverage_questions: The reported 263890 master-list AppIDs and 239664 stored application rows are distinct counts; the 24226 difference is not independently attributed to removals, refunds, free games or never-sellers.
The separately reported 56% detail-request success metric is not stated as 56% of the stored application rows; it must not be substituted for the row retention rate.
Applications include games, DLC, demos, software and media; a non-game AppID must not enter the denominator of initially paid base-game launches.
A one-period storefront crawl does not recover the originally paid status or first playable paid release date of every prior game, including delisted ones.
Reported API retrieval failures may involve geographic restrictions, nonpublic records, temporary failures or other unverified causes; no per-cause rates can be assigned from the aggregate report.
The published dataset includes reviewer identifiers and review text; Mercata imports no game, reviewer or buyer records and retains only attributed source-level aggregate methods and counts.
